title: PrefillLast unguarded against int8 KV; writes f16 K/V into int8 cache
reason: Product admission guard prefillOK/PrefillLast never checks the -kv i8 option, treating int8 KV as default f16; overrun and wrong K/V are caused by that miss.

severity: Critical (non-default: ctx > 4096 with hd > 128, or fused attention off)
title: Exact attention_prefill overflows threadgroup sc[4096] above 4096 keys
reason: No unregistered option/family; a fixed 4096-float threadgroup score array is exceeded by reachable contexts up to 32768 with no check.
option_or_family: threadgroup float sc[4096] in exact attention_prefill (nKeys > 4096)
path_missed: PrefillLast bounds only startPos+len <= ctxCap, not the exact kernel's 4096-key array

title: Small-M prefill passes pay 64-row tile at 24-32 threadgroups
reason: Pure performance: GEMM tile shape and occupancy at small M; no registration miss, limit or wrong numerics.

title: 64-token prefill floor is a gate floor; short prompts run sequentially
reason: Performance: short prompts take the slower exact path because no fidelity cell was gated; correct output, no miss or bound.

title: Small-M prefill attention at depth likely latency-bound; table stale
reason: Performance/occupancy question of the steel kernel at small M; the stale table is evidence, not the defect.

title: HiddenLast embeddings run one synchronous command buffer per token
reason: Performance of the embeddings path (no pipelining); output is correct, no registration miss or bound.

title: hd=64 models never reach the flash-decode attention kernels
reason: canUseAttnFA explicitly declines hd!=128 by recorded scope and the legacy path is correct; fix is a new templated kernel, so performance.

title: attention_fa_blk instantiated only for group sizes 6 and 7
reason: Other G fall to the correct but slower attention_fa by deliberate scope; performance, not a correctness registration miss. R vs O considered.

title: 1536-key decode attention floor measured on the kernel it no longer gates
reason: Stale performance crossover threshold; both kernels compute correctly, no limit exceeded, so performance tuning.

title: SA-family GEMV lane mapping idles half the last trip
reason: Kernel lane-utilisation performance at K=1536/3584; no wrong output or bound.

title: Down projection stays on slow coal GEMV body after R18
reason: Revisit of a performance negative: down GEMV bandwidth; correctness unaffected.

title: Paged-expert f16 scale cache duplicates mmap-aliased scales (1.43 GB)
reason: Memory footprint duplication with no wrong output and no fixed limit exceeded; resource use, so O.

title: Fit guards ignore Metal's 32768 ceiling and f16 KV pricing
reason: Planner's per-backend ceiling exists for webgpu but not metal, treating Metal as default (no ceiling, f32 KV); fix registers it. R vs B: Metal itself checks the cap.
path_missed: Plan("metal") / guardGIWFit / guardFit ceiling and KV-precision pricing

title: Paged-MoE prefill runs as M paged decode tokens
reason: prefillOK declines paged MoE by name, pinned as intended; the cost is performance/missing feature, not a registration miss.

title: No batched DeltaNet prefill; hybrids prefill as decode tokens
reason: DeltaNet is explicitly declined from PrefillLast and the sequential path is correct; missing feature and performance.

title: Host-grouped MoE expert loop: many dispatches, syncs, 64-row padding
reason: Dispatch fan-out, per-layer sync and tile padding are performance; no correctness miss or bound.

title: MoE router top-k runs on a single GPU thread
reason: Single-thread routing is correct but slow; performance revisit of a deliberate design.

title: gpt-oss MXFP4 weights requantised to int4 absmax/7
reason: Deliberate lossy requant; severity rests on 0.6 GB memory plus unquantified fidelity, a missing native feature. N vs O: not an arithmetic bug.

title: Short prompts could use bit-identical 8-row step instead of sequential
reason: Performance: an existing exact kernel could serve short prompts faster; no miss, bound or wrong numerics.

title: Expert-major MoE prefill default ON on a dense-only gate
reason: Defect is in the gate: dense-model fidelity gate and weak tiny-fixture cosine tests cannot see the MoE path; no hand-written list omission.

title: Production steel prefill attention kernel has no default-run assertion
reason: Test/gate coverage defect: only log-only, env-gated harnesses exercise attention_prefill_steel.

title: MC3, chunked-prefill and spec-verify gates env-gated; invariance record predates steel
reason: Gates skip by default and the cited invariance record measured a different kernel; a gate/record defect.

title: Context-ceiling 'fact' test only asserts two constants
reason: A test documented as guaranteeing the ceiling checks constants only and cannot see F-C02; claim/test mismatch.
